requirements.title: Reaction is a special action enabled by a rule source
Reaction is an instant trigger response available on any creature's turn
Opportunity Attack is the most common Reaction type
Taking a Reaction spends the Reaction until the start of the reactor's next turn
An interrupted creature continues its turn after the Reaction
Reaction timing defaults to immediately after the trigger unless the Reaction says otherwise
